gap_register.summary: The direct ult_sf_rel branch lands in LOADRELATIONSHIPS_INGEST; no checked evidence joins it to the account-relationship RAW route.
ult_sf_rel captures DWREL.TXT, which does not match the DWREL{HEAD} output name (DWREL01A.TXT), so the graph has no CARRIED_BY edge from the KWDW_ACC extract to it and it is excluded from this slice.
The DWREL extract to ult_s3_rel1 association is inferred from the Capture.Pattern filename match.
ult_s3_rel2 is included through the shared HVR location it captures from; the stored edge points from the channel to the location, so a stored-direction walk does not continue past that location.
